steps.en: Officer has finished choosing addresses for the work order
steps.id: Officer sudah selesai memilih address untuk work order
steps.why_en: Nothing in the staff portal lets an officer pick addresses for a work order.
steps.why_id: Portal staff tidak punya fitur untuk memilih address work order.

steps.en: The full list of IDs for the work order is shown on screen
steps.id: Daftar lengkap ID untuk work order tampil di layar
steps.why_en: The only work order screen is switched off and fetches no data.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya layar work order dimatikan dan tidak mengambil data.

steps.en: Each row shows warrant dates, visit dates, numbers and address
steps.id: Tiap baris menampilkan tanggal warrant, tanggal kunjungan, nomor, dan address
steps.why_en: Only unrelated columns exist, and past visit dates are not stored anywhere.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada kolom yang tidak terkait, dan tanggal kunjungan tidak disimpan di mana pun.

steps.en: Officer reviews the list, then continues to amend it
steps.id: Officer me-review daftar, lalu lanjut mengubahnya
steps.why_en: There is no review screen to open.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar review yang bisa dibuka.
